name: Spam
description:
Unwanted or repetitive promotional messages,
bots, or irrelevant content.

name: Copyright or IP Violation
description:
Sharing content that
infringes on copyrights or intellectual property rights.

name: Other
description:
Violations that do not fit the categories
above.

name: Sexual Content
description:
Explicit or inappropriate sexual
messages, especially when unsolicited.

name: Child Safety
description:
Harmful, exploitative, or inappropriate
content involving minors.

name: Scams or Fraud
description:
Attempts to steal money, personal
information, or trick users through deception.

name: Self-Harm or Suicide
description:
Messages expressing intent to
self-harm or encouraging others to do so.

name: Misinformation
description:
False or misleading claims that may
cause harm or confusion.

name: Privacy Violation
description: Sharing or requesting personal information without consent.

name: Impersonation
description:
Pretending to be another person,
organization, or official representative.

name: Harassment
description:
Abusive, insulting, or threatening
messages directed at a person or group.

name: Hate Speech
description:
Messages that promote, encourage,
or threaten physical harm or dangerous acts.
